result.stdout:
Topoi Quantum CLI

Usage:
  tq [options]

Options:
  --help, -h                  Show command-line help
  --qubits <n>, -q <n>         Number of qubits to initialise, default 1
  --qasm <path>                Load and run an executable OpenQASM 3 program
  --run <path>                 Run a full interpreter script and exit
  --circuit <path>             Load and run a gate-only QuantumCircuit file and exit
  --print-circuit              Print loaded circuit before execution
  --draw                       Draw loaded circuit before execution
  --print                      Print final state amplitudes and probabilities
  --probs                      Print final basis-state probabilities
  --expect "observable"        Print expectation value, e.g. --expect "ZZ 0 1"
  --sample <n>                 Sample final state n times

Examples:
  tq --qubits 2 --run examples/bell.qc
  tq --qubits 2 --circuit circuits/bell.qc --print-circuit --print
  tq --qubits 2 --circuit circuits/bell.qc --expect "ZZ 0 1" --expect "XX 0 1"
  tq --qubits 3 --circuit circuits/ghz3.qc --probs --sample 1000
  tq --qubits 2 --circuit circuits/bell.qc --draw --expect "ZZ 0 1"
  tq --qasm examples/bell.qasm --draw --print --expect "ZZ 0 1"
